title: Important Updates on the Funding Rate of USDⓈ-M SKHYNIXUSDT, SAMSUNGUSDT and HYUNDAIUSDT Perpetual Contracts (2026-07-14)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance constantly reviews its product and service offerings to ensure the best user experience for all users. Effective from  2026-07-14 16:15 (UTC) , Binance Futures will adjust the funding interval of  SKHYNIXUSDT, SAMSUNGUSDT  and  HYUNDAIUSDT  Perpetual Contracts from every eight hours to every four hours. The funding cap/floor  of the aforementioned contracts will be adjusted to ± 0.50%, with details as follows: SKHYNIXUSDT, SAMSUNGUSDT and HYUNDAIUSDT Perpetual Contracts:  Time (UTC) Max Funding Rate SKHYNIXUSDT SAMSUNGUSDT and HYUNDAIUSDT 2026-07-14 16:00 +0.50% / -0.50% +2.00% / -2.00% 2026-07-14 20:00 +0.50% / -0.50% +0.50% / -0.50% 2026-07-15 00:00 +0.50% / -0.50% +0.50% / -0.50% 2026-07-15 04:00 +0.50% / -0.50% +0.50% / -0.50% … … … For More Information: Introduction to Binance Futures Funding Rates Note:   This information is released as a Notice under Binance  Exchange Rule  17. The aforementioned perpetual contract(s) are exempted from  8.1 Adjustment of Funding Interval  rules. The funding interval will  not  be adjusted from every eight hours to every one hour when the previous funding rate settlement of the aforementioned perpetual contract(s) reach the funding rate cap or floor.  A separate announcement will be made if Binance decides to adjust the funding interval.  Based on market risk conditions, Binance may adjust the specifications of the aforementioned Futures contract(s) from time to time, which include the funding fee, tick size, maximum leverage, initial margin, and/or maintenance margin requirements. In case there is a discrepancy between this notice and any Futures FAQ, please refer to this notice for the most accurate and updated information. There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-07-14
